name: Filled Cliffspring Falls Sampler
summary: Near Cliffspring Falls in Darkshore, the Filled Cliffspring Falls Sampler holds foul water drawn from the headwaters. The Cenarion Circle needs it to study the sickness striking local deer.

sections.title: A Tainted Source
sections.body: Cliffspring Falls carries water from the eastern highlands through much of Darkshore. Now local deer are falling ill with an unnatural sickness. At Dendrite Starblaze’s request in Moonglade, druidic initiates draw water from a cave mouth where hostile naga dwell. The vial holds visibly foul water, proof that the fresh supply is tainted.

sections.title: Path to a Remedy
sections.body: Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine receives the foul water for the Cenarion Circle to study. Rather than discard it, Alanndarian examines its poison. By learning the sludge’s properties, the druids can make a curative salve. That is an essential step toward a rite that gives practitioners power over poison.

faq.q: What is inside the Filled Cliffspring Falls Sampler?
aliases: what water is in the vial
faq.answer: The sampler holds contaminated water drawn from a cavern mouth near Cliffspring Falls in Darkshore. The water is visibly discolored and carries the poison sickening local deer.

faq.q: Who asks for this water sample?
aliases: who do i give the sampler to
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle asks young druids to collect the sample. Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine receives it to study the poison and formulate a cure.

faq.q: Why is Cliffspring Falls so important?
faq.answer: Cliffspring Falls is Darkshore’s principal source of drinking water. Corruption in the falls spreads through local waterways and harms the wilderness.

faq.q: What is causing the water to turn foul?
faq.answer: Hostile naga have overrun a cave near the headwaters, where the water is drawn. Their presence coincides with fouled water and sickness among local animals.

angles.text: As a druid, retrieving and studying this tainted water gives you a proving trial. It also lays the groundwork for mastering Cure Poison.
As a night elf of Darkshore, you help secure the Cliffspring headwaters and protect Auberdine’s ecology from foul foreign corruption.
